messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: How to send data from a simple javascript to shiny
parts:
Hi,

I know little about javascript. I am using the slider from Jquery UI package. At the meantime, I want to save minimum value of slider bar in javascript and send this to the shiny output. I am trying to use 'Shiny.onInputChange', however, have not got it work. I am not sure whether something wrong with my js code or I am missing something.

Here is my javascript code:

$(function(){
    $('#slider-jq').slider({
range: false,
min: 1,
max: 1000,
values: [200, 500],
slide: function(event, ui){
   $('#barvalue').val(ui.values[0]+'-'+ ui.values[1]);
}
    });
    $('#barvalue').val($('#slider-jq').slider('values',0)+'-'+$('#slider-jq').slider('values',1));
    
  var barmin=$('#slider-jq').slider('values',0);
    Shiny.onInputChange("jq",barmin);
});

I highlighted the part where I want to save the data. In the shiny UI part, I have 'includeScript('jqslider.js') to embed the js code, and also have  'tags$div(id='slider-jq')' to get the slider bar. In the server part, I tried to print out the variable barmin as the code:
 output$jqslider<-renderPrint({     ## jqslider was defined in the ui part.
  input$jq
  })    

Any suggestion on this? Thanks a lot.

messages.subject: Re: How to send data from a simple javascript to shiny
parts:
Yes, that is the only one JS error I got.

OK, I did some research on this. I changed the code below in my JS file and get it work.

(old)

var barmin=$('#slider-jq').slider('values',0);
    Shiny.onInputChange("jq",barmin);
(new)
var barmin=$('#slider-jq').slider('values',0);

setTimeout(function(){ Shiny.onInputChange("jq",barmin);},0);

It seems it has to wait for Shiny loading 'shiny.js' or something that has "Shiny.onInputChange' defined. Without wait time by setTimeout, Shiny.onInputChange cannot be recognized. Do you think this is the reason why my previous code does not work?

Thanks.
